F.title: CBDC Interoperability Model

variantsList.name: BANK_ONLY
variantsList.description: Commercial/regulated institutions interact with MTQ. Central bank NOT directly in loop; settlement happens bank-to-bank via MTQ.
variantsList.whenToUse: Default mode for cross-border B2B settlement where central banks have not authorized direct participation.

variantsList.name: CB_CONNECTED
variantsList.description: Banks settle through a central-bank or wholesale-CBDC interface. Central bank is settlement agent but does NOT directly hold MTQ.
variantsList.whenToUse: When central bank has wholesale-CBDC system (FedNow, BOJ-NET, ECB digital-euro wholesale, Project mBridge).

variantsList.name: CB_DIRECT
variantsList.description: Central bank itself participates directly in MTQ layer as Class A participant. Can hold/transfer/redeem MTQ; CANNOT mint MTQ (directMinting=false).
variantsList.whenToUse: Rare; requires explicit sovereign authorization (statutory or regulatory).

honestGaps: No wholesale-CBDC system integrations exist in production
Mode 3 (CB_DIRECT) is theoretical — no central bank has authorized direct participation
checkCBDCInterop() verifies the flow is in the supported list, but does NOT execute the actual wCBDC transfer
The 5 canonical flows are documented but NOT all unit-tested in the off-chain module
